page.content:
Ge Xuan informed the Jade Emperor when a messenger girl came up to Heaven with a memorandum from Ksitigarbha about how Sun Wukong had erased names from the Register of Life and Death.

page.overview:
Who is Ge Xuan?

Ge Xuan informed the Jade Emperor when a messenger girl came up to Heaven with a memorandum from Ksitigarbha about how Sun Wukong had erased names from the Register of Life and Death.

Ge Xuan later greeted Sun Wukong at the Hall of Miraculous Mist when he wanted an audience with the Jade Emperor.
